from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class UniversityMetric(BaseModel):
    """Represents the data extracted for a single university from a CDS report."""
    name: str | None = Field(description="Name of the university")
    enrollment: float | None = Field(description="Grand total enrollment (Section B1)")
    instructional_faculty: float | None = Field(description="Total instructional faculty (full-time + part-time) (Section I-1)")
    graduation_rate_2015: float | None = Field(description="Six-year graduation rate for Fall 2015 cohort (Section B4)")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    universities: list[UniversityMetric]
